column2: the Authority shall be vested in a Board of Directors (in this
Act referred to as the “Board”), consisting of the following

(a)
the  Governor  of  the  Central  Bank  of  Sri
Lanka, or a person nominated by him as his
representative, who shall be the Chairperson

(b)
the  Secretary  to  the  Treasury  or  a  person
nominated by him as his representative;
